## Sub-Chat-Cloud v1.0 (2026-05-24)
通用 chat 子工作流。被 #02/#03/#03b/#05 用 Execute Workflow 呼叫。
輸入: { ai_provider, system_prompt, user_content, model, ollama_url, ollama_api_key, cloud_ai_url, cloud_ai_key } → 回 { ...輸入, output }

--- v1.0.3 2026-05-30: Deploy-ready cleanup (strip readonly fields, dedupe node names, redirect Sub-Chat-Local→Cloud, sentinel for deploy_n8n.py id-rewire)
--- v1.0.6 2026-05-31: Removed hardcoded URL fallbacks (docling/qdrant/ollama/backend) — backend now ALWAYS sends these in webhook payload. Workflow fails loud if URL missing, no silent container-name drift.
--- v1.0.15 2026-05-31: FIX local-branch bug. 原本不分 ai_provider 都打 OpenAI (line 34 lmChatOpenAi + OpenAiaccount cred)，呼叫端 ai_provider=local 時仍走雲端 → 誤用 cloud key/額度、ollama 自架完全沒被呼叫。改為 If(ai_provider==='local') 分流到兩個 HTTP Request 節點(Ollama / Cloud，皆走 OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions)，移除 langchain Agent + lmChatOpenAi (本子流程無 tool/memory 需求，純 prompt → completion，直 HTTP 等效且免 credential 設定；對齊 #04 的 Ollama/Cloud Embed 雙分支樣式)。Shape Output 同時支援兩種 response shape。
